description.text: Start Deck 100 Battle Collection, released on 16 January 2026: one of 100 ready-built 60-card decks in each box, with a sheet of damage counters and markers, so which deck a player got was left to chance; every deck holds Pokémon ex. This set holds the cards of all the decks.
